title: chat-server deletedForAll does not send Peer/retract
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 'Deleting a Message': server MUST send Peer/retract to all participants before marking local record when deletedForAll is true. Message/set handler in crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs does not. Pre-existing.
notes: Blocked: crate-jmap-chat-server has no outbound Peer/* sending path (no HTTP client dep, no ChatBackend send hook). Needs a federation transport design decision (ChatBackend peer-send hook vs injected transport trait) before deletedForAll can emit Peer/retract.
close_reason: Spec change: Peer/retract sending moved from chat-00 into federation-00 'Sender Behavior'; non-federating server has no peers to notify. Client doc comment updated.
